props.name: value
props.description: Controlled value. Pair it with onValueChange.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the current code whenever it changes.

props.name: onComplete
props.description: Called once when every box is filled.

props.name: numeric
props.description: Digits only (default), or any letters and numbers.

props.name: mask
props.description: Hide the characters, like a password.

props.name: autoFocus
props.description: Focus the first box on mount.

props.name: aria-label

props.name: className
